reservation_method: Full serialized request UTF-8 bytes plus 4096 framing tokens; all input charged at cache-write rate; no cache discount; long-context premium when bound exceeds 272000; full output cap.
stop_policy: Serial requests, retries=0, cache disabled. Persist in-flight reservation before send. Stop on first failure or unaffordable request. Further attempts require a new user decision; retain successful captures and unresolved reservations.
